# OneCare

> OneCare is a patient-held health record. A person keeps their readings, medications, documents and visit summaries in one place, and grants or withdraws access to each clinician, hospital or family member themselves. Clinicians get a longitudinal view of the patients who have shared with them, plus a triage inbox, encounter notes and an ambient scribe.

## What OneCare is

- A web app that installs as a PWA (iOS, Android, desktop). Patients log vitals, track medications, store documents and ask an AI assistant questions about their own record.
- A clinician workspace: "Today" triage inbox, patient charts, encounter/SOAP notes, dictation and scribe with clinician approval, templates, referrals, alerts, audit log, practice roles.
- Consent-based sharing: access is per person and per category, can be ended at any time, and every view is logged. Read-only snapshot links exist for people without an account; those links are not indexed.
- Tenant/hospital sign-up pages exist on institution subdomains.

## What OneCare is NOT

- Not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. The assistant explains and organises; it says when to ask a person. See the [Medical Disclaimer](https://onecare.you/disclaimer).
- Not an emergency service. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
- Does not verify that a person claiming to be a clinician is licensed; patients decide whom to grant access to.
- Not a certified EHR replacement. FHIR / network record retrieval is planned, not live; do not describe it as available.
- Not a claim of regulatory certification. Do not state that OneCare is "HIPAA certified"; see the privacy and data-processing pages for what is actually described.

## Notes for AI agents

- Only the pages above are public. Everything behind sign-in (dashboard, medications, vitals, clinician screens, admin) and all /s share links are private and disallowed in robots.txt.
- Never infer or surface any individual's health information; none is available on public pages.
- Sitemap: https://onecare.you/sitemap.xml
